reply.summary: Stirnror is a luckless masked brawler dressed in chitin-coloured armour who clings to walls and trades jokes mid-fight. He turns up wherever the neighbourhood heroes gather, never quite getting credit.

feats.scene: Stirnror hurls a lamppost across an alley into a charging zombie.
Stirnror shrugs off a falling billboard and keeps quipping.

reply.summary: Corlor is a monocled mad scientist who builds clockwork beetles and studies swarming behaviour. He sells his gadgets to anyone who funds his hidden island laboratory.

feats.scene: Corlor detonates a swarm of explosive mechanical beetles inside a warehouse.
Corlor survives a tumble down a flight of laboratory stairs.

reply.summary: Tiuam is a red-haired enforcer who warps the air around himself into a shimmering field that bends incoming blows aside. He works for a crime boss and rarely thinks past the next order.

feats.scene: Tiuam buckles a steel door by folding the air against it.
Tiuam's distortion shell deflects a speeding van into a wall.

reply.summary: Nuseonan is a goggle-eyed thief who inherited a family trade of robbing jewellers with trick lenses and smoke pellets. He is more theatrical than dangerous.

feats.scene: Nuseonan flings a smoke pellet that fills a shop with fog.
Nuseonan lands on his back from a second-storey window and runs off.

reply.summary: Allsete is a vast green-eyed sea serpent that haunts a drowned settlement, smashing its gates and scattering its guards. Repeated defeats never keep it away for long.

feats.scene: Allsete coils around a seabed fortress wall and crushes it to rubble.
Allsete takes a volley of harpoon cannons without bleeding.

reply.summary: Miaaman is a brown-haired underworld footman who runs errands for a city syndicate. He hides in alleys and relies on a battered pistol and a loud mouth.

feats.scene: Miaaman clubs a rival courier with a pipe.
Miaaman is thrown through a shop window and gets up cursing.

reply.summary: Laron is a bald hauler from a red giant's world who was handed a counterfeit power ring and promptly used it to carry wardrobes. He claims the title of mightiest mover in creation.

feats.scene: Laron lifts a whole apartment block's worth of sofas on a ring-made platform.
Laron takes a punch from a rival lantern and only blinks.

reply.summary: Irnsas is a brown-furred canine hero who patrols the void between star systems with a pack of fellow dogs. His alien body shrugs off hazards that would flatten a human.

feats.scene: Irnsas rams a drifting asteroid chunk and shatters it.
Irnsas tanks a meteor strike on his flank and keeps barking orders.

reply.summary: Rnuse is a blue-furred canine whose ears sprout horns when he gets angry, charging like a bull at any threat. He teams up with other space dogs to track down a mischievous feline.

feats.scene: Rnuse head-butts a mutated cat into a stack of crates.
Rnuse withstands a mutant's swipe and charges back.

reply.summary: Tornen is a blond ex-convict strongman who now digs tunnels for a team of underground explorers. His bare hands are as useful as any drill when the rock is stubborn.

feats.scene: Tornen splits a boulder blocking a tunnel with a sledgehammer.
Tornen holds up a collapsing mine beam long enough for the crew to escape.

reply.summary: Stustinu is a brown-furred dog who rides along with his owner on costumed patrols, barking at crooks and snapping at their ankles. He is loyal to the point of recklessness.

feats.scene: Stustinu bowls over a purse-snatcher at a run.
Stustinu tumbles off a moving cart and bounds back up.

reply.summary: Rortesria is a white-furred hound in a pack of wartime canine soldiers who answers to a gruff commander. He charges in first and thinks afterwards.

feats.scene: Rortesria leaps onto a guard and pins him to the ground.
Rortesria slides down a rocky ravine and trots off unharmed.

reply.summary: Nironrum is a veteran masked champion who wears a gravity-bending helmet and fights for a grand alliance in a bleak future. He falls in a prison riot.

feats.scene: Nironrum flings himself through a cell block wall with his helmet bending his weight.
Nironrum is hurled across a courtyard by a blast and keeps standing.

reply.summary: Torvaco is a robber with enormous strength and skin that turns bullets, who shoots himself in the skull as a sales pitch before demanding the till. He has no larger ambition than quick cash.

feats.scene: Torvaco tears a vault door from its hinges.
Torvaco fires a pistol into his own head and sneers at the dent in the slug.

reply.summary: Riasilto is a smooth-talking crook who cons two apprentice wizards into helping with a vault job. He prefers lies to violence and is easily caught.

feats.scene: Riasilto shoves a teller over a counter.
Riasilto hits the pavement while fleeing and is cuffed.

reply.summary: Ialserlan is a British costumed adventurer with a songbird motif who patrols the countryside lanes on a bicycle, tipping her hat to villagers and taking down petty criminals.

feats.scene: Ialserlan cracks a poacher's rifle with a staff swing.
Ialserlan rolls out of a speeding lorry's path.

reply.summary: Iumreonti is a swaggering brute from a hellish world of fire pits, employed to grab troublesome heroes but too proud to follow orders. One punch of his sends two champions reeling.

feats.scene: Iumreonti drives a single fist into a pair of rivals and sends them tumbling across a plaza.
Iumreonti ignores a tank shell striking his chest.

reply.summary: Tesrum is a grey-eyed garage mechanic who tunes race cars and later raises his friend's daughter as his own. He is warm, steady, and handy with a wrench.

feats.scene: Tesrum cranks a seized engine bolt loose with a long wrench.
Tesrum falls from a pit ladder and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Osaren is a black-haired street swindler who fakes injuries to beg coins and then joins a count in a sham charity scheme. He is dangerously violent when cornered.

feats.scene: Osaren swings a cosh at a guard in a manor library.
Osaren drops onto cobblestones on purpose and rises smiling.

reply.summary: Lesau is a bald, bow-legged convict turned amusement pier owner who hardens himself against the world like a crustacean. He runs a rigged boardwalk from a sunken hideout.

feats.scene: Lesau snaps a plank with a long-armed grab.
Lesau takes a beating from a stretchy lawman and keeps scheming.

reply.summary: Amcorllo is a brown-haired gangster who wears a floppy-eared mask and robs night clubs, leaving a carrot at the scene. He is out of his depth against a masked heroine.

feats.scene: Amcorllo cracks a revolver butt on a doorman's skull.
Amcorllo falls through a skylight and limps away.

reply.summary: Rumanran is a patient scribe on a coastal strand of a dying planet who records his father-in-law's inventions and marries into the family. His careful notes outlive his age.

feats.scene: Rumanran hauls a heavy net of shellfish onto the shore.
Rumanran stands in a surging tide that knocks others over.

reply.summary: Stieosor is a bald stuntman gone bad who stages crimes as scenes from old cinema, scripted dialogue and all. He wants the audience he feels he was denied.

feats.scene: Stieosor blows open a studio safe with a staged prop charge.
Stieosor leaps from a rooftop onto a stack of boxes without a scratch.

reply.summary: Sernuvos is a grey, balding retired air force officer who once headed a secret agency. He reluctantly spills its secrets to two reporters out of contempt for his successor.

feats.scene: Sernuvos slams a fist on his kitchen table in anger.
Sernuvos endures a long interrogation of questions without breaking composure.

reply.summary: Iumser is a black-haired swordsman who appears as a hidden figure in a children's puzzle show. He is a quiet ally of a band of teen heroes.

feats.scene: Iumser slices a wooden practice post in half with a katana.
Iumser blocks a thrown prop with the flat of his blade.

reply.summary: Ntrus is a fast and agile swordsman who guards a crowded island city, taking on ninja gangs alongside visiting heroes. He is eventually frozen and later thawed to join a counterstrike.

feats.scene: Ntrus cuts down three masked attackers in a single sweep.
Ntrus is thrown into a brick wall and stays conscious.
Ntrus dashes across a rooftop to intercept a thrown star.

reply.summary: Raniuta is a bald hired killer armed with an arsenal of gadgets who takes contracts from a shadowy planning syndicate. His reliance on devices is his flaw.

feats.scene: Raniuta fires a rocket dart that blows a car door off its frame.
Raniuta rolls from a collapsing scaffold and continues the hunt.

reply.summary: Cenuiar is a black-haired island partisan who shelters a stranded soldier and trains him in throws and holds. He supplies fighters and scouting reports to the cause.

feats.scene: Cenuiar flips a rifleman over his hip and onto sand.
Cenuiar endures a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps teaching.

reply.summary: Arstu is a brawler grown in a lab from mixed human and shapeshifting alien stock, built to battle a divine-fire champion. He inherits siblings with odd elemental talents.

feats.scene: Arstu rips a streetlight pole free and swings it at his foe.
Arstu takes a falling beam to the shoulder without staggering.

reply.summary: Sornu is a bald thug who worked for a clown crime lord before drifting into a gang of copycats. He is muscle with few ideas of his own.

feats.scene: Sornu throws a heavy punch that dents a trash can.
Sornu is hit with a bat and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Tilti is a being of pure fury, a living aspect of a cosmic spectrum of emotion, who lashes out with crimson blasts and cannot truly die. Its home is a red-lit world of eternal bloodshed.

feats.scene: Tilti vomits a torrent of crimson fury that cracks open a mountain range.
Tilti absorbs a barrage of planetary-scale blasts and snarls undamaged.

reply.summary: Mivaial is a bald alien dealer who sends hired killers after travellers on a pilgrimage and folds as soon as his champion falls.

feats.scene: Mivaial slaps a servant across the room.
Mivaial hits the floor of his lounge and wheezes.

reply.summary: Liunienu is a black-haired schoolboy at a prep school who befriends the young vigilante in his class and helps with homework and gossip.

feats.scene: Liunienu throws a football across a quad.
Liunienu trips on the dormitory stairs and walks it off.

reply.summary: Numrau is a three-foot four-legged scout with many-faceted eyes, huge fan ears, and a skin that mimics its surroundings. He swears like a soldier and always gets there first.

feats.scene: Numrau kicks a guard off a catwalk before fading from view.
Numrau survives a grenade blast behind a crate.
Numrau sprints ahead of the squad through dense brush.

reply.summary: Necar is a blonde white-eyed mercenary whose voice can lull and command minds. She works in tandem with a fire-wielder, stalking prey for her employer.

feats.scene: Necar speaks a command that makes a sentry turn his rifle on the wall.
Necar takes a hard fall onto concrete and rolls clear.

reply.summary: Orallla is a white-skinned, blue-eyed widow who stalks the night with a blade, driven by grief and a desire for fearsome reputation. She slips her sword through solid matter.

feats.scene: Orallla drives a phased blade through a steel girder and wounds a giant of a man.
Orallla clutches a razor edge in her bare palm and does not bleed.

reply.summary: Rilllli is a black-haired reporter who manufactures his own headlines by staging robberies under a hooded persona. He is eventually exposed by a red-clad hero.

feats.scene: Rilllli shoves over a shelf of ledgers to cover his escape.
Rilllli slips on a staircase and picks himself up.

reply.summary: Iumleran is a pale, black-haired widow from a quiet world who wears a power ring and hunts renegade machines, then drifts between factions after the corps falls apart.

feats.scene: Iumleran moulds a green hammer from her ring and crushes a rogue android.
Iumleran's ring shield absorbs a barrage of cannon fire.

reply.summary: Aulte is a pale black-haired ring bearer who escorts allies to a distant planet to calm a frightened newcomer, projecting beams and shields with iron resolve.

feats.scene: Aulte lances a glowing beam into an asteroid and splits it.
Aulte's shield stands against a meteor swarm.

reply.summary: Teltiu is a schoolteacher who dons a frosty costume and hides as a masked extortionist, freezing victims with a snow cannon and mechanical servants. Her father's experiment fuels the scheme.

feats.scene: Teltiu fires a frozen jet that encases an aeroplane in ice.
Teltiu tumbles from her mountain perch and is arrested.

reply.summary: Aulium is a blue-eyed thief in a robotic suit who wields a magic hat that sprays snow and a pipe that fires icicles. She is smitten by an alien visitor and killed protecting him.

feats.scene: Aulium sprays frozen shards from her pipe into a museum wall.
Aulium takes a punch in her armour and staggers.

reply.summary: Auora is a former guard whose exposure to strange materials made his flesh dense and his strength immense. After tragedy he becomes a hired killer, vulnerable only to focused beams.

feats.scene: Auora flips an armoured van onto its side with bare hands.
Auora takes a flurry of rifle fire and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Sauorino is one of the earliest masked adventurers, wearing a winged costume and fighting crime in a retro-styled city before joining an old vigilante crew.

feats.scene: Sauorino swings a rope from a rooftop and kicks a mugger.
Sauorino lands from a high fall and rolls upright.

reply.summary: Ialli is a blue-eyed teenager from a bygone decade who half-died under a crashed craft and was revived by glowing slime that covers half of him. He flings burning goo and rides an alien bike.

feats.scene: Ialli flings a clot of caustic slime that eats through a door.
Ialli reforms his body after a crushing blow.

reply.summary: Tiauori is a bald red-eyed winged commander who despises the planet he is posted to and tricks a loyal subordinate into a deadly mistake before arresting him.

feats.scene: Tiauori levels an arms deal with a single blast from his blaster.
Tiauori stays upright after a thrown crate hits his chest.

reply.summary: Iasll is a tiny red-eyed ring bearer, no bigger than a fly, whose mighty will conjures enormous constructs. He joins his fellows at an urgent assembly.

feats.scene: Iasll builds a huge glowing fist from his ring and flattens a fortress door.
Iasll's ring shield holds against a burst of enemy fire.

reply.summary: Inauos is an insect-sized ring bearer with famous willpower, a quick tactician for stealth jobs who can also sting foes into stupor with venom. He tracks a fugitive onto a living planet.

feats.scene: Inauos shapes a huge green wall from his ring to stop a pirate fleet.
Inauos is swatted aside and flies on undamaged.

reply.summary: Iutirn is a villain whose whole body is stuffed with straw, a theatrical robber who forces a theatre crowd to watch his own performance. Rain ends his scheme.

feats.scene: Iutirn shoves over a stage prop onto an usher.
Iutirn takes a punch that only scatters loose straw.

reply.summary: Telte is a yellow-orange reptilian demigod and sorcerer who ruled an ancient city as a cruel deity for a thousand years, then crawled back from exile to scheme in a modern city.

feats.scene: Telte calls up a surge of dark soil magic that levels a city block.
Telte wades through a mob's blazing torches and spells without burns.

reply.summary: Eolost is a quiet black-haired pilot and mechanic who flies a streaking blue aircraft for a patriotic hero team under heavy fire. He stays with the squad when the craft is wrecked.

feats.scene: Eolost rams his aircraft's nose into an enemy drone and tears it apart.
Eolost walks out of a crash landing with only bruises.
Eolost banks his craft through a canyon at top speed.
